goal: Prove opt-in Rust cuda-oxide SwiGLU clamp and exponential semantics through the repaired libdevice link path while retaining the existing directional ownership and no default route claim.

covered_behavior: swiglu_kernel finite and NaN clamp behavior, unclamped behavior, SiLU exponential, output weighting, and 256-thread elementwise launch
ds4_gpu_swiglu_tensor buffer validation and kernel launch
excluded_behavior: runtime graph integration and default CUDA route

rust_owned_in_this_stage: current-C-shaped clamp, SiLU exponential, weight, and bounds semantics
portable PTX plus context-targeted libdevice cubin loading path
not_claimed_in_this_stage: runtime graph integration or default CUDA route

libdevice_repair.resolved_boundary: Rust f32::exp() emits __nv_expf in portable PTX; cuda-host now links NVIDIA libdevice into a context-targeted sm_103 cubin before module load.
libdevice_repair.regression_proof: cuda-oxide primitive_stress executes its float-math intrinsic set on B300 without CUDA_OXIDE_TARGET or CUDA_OXIDE_LINK_TARGET overrides.
